messages:
anne: Heads-up — incoming third-party pentest scheduled for next Wed (window: 2024-08-14 09:00-17:00 UTC). Need final plan for RBAC/evidence access, KMS creds, and log export packaging.

samir: Thanks — can we confirm what level of access they actually need? prefer least-priv. My suggestion: ephemeral service account scoped to specific S3 prefix + CloudWatch log-read only.

tyler: Agreed. Also we need to block any ability to modify KMS keys. They only need decrypt for retrieving artifacts if we hand them anything encrypted, but ideally we provide presigned downloads.

kevin: @samir I'll build an ephemeral role with duration 8h and restricted to the pen-test S3 prefix (bucket: redwood-pt-evidence). Will add CloudWatch Logs:FilterLogEvents + S3:GetObject. No kms:CreateGrant or kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion.

maria: Do we want to give them direct S3 access or hand them presigned URLs? Presigned URLs avoid giving kms:Decrypt if objects are encrypted with a KMS CMK.

samir: Presigned URLs + SSE-S3 avoids KMS involvement. If we must use a CMK (for compliance), create a wrapped download flow: a short-lived lambda that decrypts and returns content via pre-authenticated link. But that adds audit complexity.

anne: Compliance prefers CMK-backed at-rest. Can we export evidence bucket with SSE-KMS, but hand out presigned GETs generated by an internal service account that has kms:Decrypt? That way the testers never get KMS perms.

kevin: Yep. Implementation plan: objects stored SSE-KMS, presigned URLs generated by an internal 'pt-access' role that has kms:Decrypt for the single alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:alias/pt-evidence-key. The presigned URLs expire after 30m.

pen-test-bot: NOTE: Reminder created — upload evidence manifest to /manifests/pt-aug14.json by 2024-08-13 17:00 UTC.

tyler: For RBAC mapping we need to outline SAML group -> AWS role mapping for the assessors. Example mapping snippet for the IdP team: 
```
<RoleMapping>
  <SAMLGroup>pen-testers@example.com</SAMLGroup>
  <AWSRole>arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/PT-Assessor-Role</AWSRole>
</RoleMapping>
```

samir: Also ensure CloudTrail is turned on in all regions and logs are exported to the audit bucket with ACL locked. We'll create a separate folder audit-exports/pt-aug14 and snapshot current policies.

maria: Quick question on log sampling: testers will need API-level traces for a specific time range. We'll export CloudWatch Logs with start/end times and include the lambda tracing spans. This will be a separate package (logs-export-aug14.tar.gz).

anne: Remediation tracker: I created a temporary GH issue board (private org repo) to track findings, owners, sev, and ETA. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pt-aug14 (private). Please add initial remediation owners before test.

kevin: I've added the S3 policy and the presign generator lambda. IAM role ARN: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/PT-Presign-Generator. Testers will not have direct KMS permissions.

samir: Can we get a quick dry-run Friday? Run presign generation and test download from an ephemeral account to validate expiries and access errors.

anne: Yes. Dry-run Friday 15:00 UTC. @kevin pls post test checklist. Action items: kevin (presigned flow + audit config), samir (ephemeral role + SAML mapping), maria (log exports + manifest), tyler (CloudTrail snapshot), anne (GH tracker + vendor contact).

kevin: Will do. Test checklist (short):
- create temp assessor user
- request presigned URL -> expect 200 within 30m
- try direct S3:GetObject without presign -> expect AccessDenied
- attempt kms:Decrypt with assessor creds -> expect AccessDenied
- verify CloudTrail entry for presign generation

maria: I'll prepare the logs-export-aug14.tar.gz and upload to redwood-pt-evidence/exports/ and add manifest entry.

pen-test-bot: WINDOW CONFIRMED — External assessor group accepted the scheduled slot.

anne: Great. If anything blocks, flag here. Keep updates short. :thumbsup:
